native_mechanisms: Chained sequential pour: each mark is folded into the one stained cup and the cup's new colour becomes the seed for the next mark, so the whole buffer passes through as a single unbroken chain, each byte consumed once and never alone

Seven-fold organ bending of the final colour: the accumulator is pushed through seven successive invertible bendings, each discarding about half of what it received (shift ~half the register) and keeping only the restless bits
Single-bit-flip avalanche verification: change one arbitrary byte/bit in the buffer, re-run the whole pour, and reject the entire method if the new token still resembles the old
core_technique: Length-tiered hash: bulk data absorbed by 2–4 parallel hardware CRC32C lanes (or, without SSE4.2, 4 parallel xor-multiply lanes), lanes plus length combined and finished with the stock 7-step mx3 xor-shift/multiply avalanche finalizer
